construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.feedback: List of unique {id, text, severity}; severity is low, medium, high, critical
shared_schema.sources: knowledge_base and research_sources each contain unique {id, title, text} records
shared_schema.results: Cumulative stage-keyed arrays in severity-aware priority order, linked by feedback_id
shared_schema.validation: Strict fields and types; synthetic=true; bounded lists/text; duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers rejected; derived records recomputed to verify exact lineage and evidence at every transition
shared_schema.citation: {source_id, title, start, end, quote}; Unicode character offsets, zero-based start and exclusive end; quote exactly equals source text slice
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and error text; CLI exit 2

cross_stage_handoffs.consumption: FAQ retrieves from the sentiment record text and preserves severity-aware record order and priority
Research uses original query plus grounded FAQ answer; explicit FAQ abstention falls back to original query and remains visible as faq_status

behavior.sentiment: Published weighted lexicon, casefolded Unicode tokens, immediate preceding not/never/no flips contribution; score sum and all token contributions exposed
behavior.priority: P0 critical; P1 high severity or score<=-3; P2 medium severity or negative score; otherwise P3. Sort by priority, severity descending, score ascending, feedback ID.
behavior.retrieval: Sentence/newline chunks; lexical set overlap after stopwords; requires >=2 matched terms and >=20% query-term coverage. Rank by overlap, coverage, source ID and start offset.
behavior.faq: Top one qualifying KB passage returned verbatim; otherwise null answer and explicit abstention reason
behavior.normal: Top three qualifying research passages returned verbatim with exact citations; otherwise explicit abstention reason
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: All input/example/test material is clearly labeled synthetic and makes no real-world claims
behavior.determinism: No randomness, time-dependent decisions, models, or network calls

test_outcomes.cli_result: Exactly one valid JSON object; status ok; stage normal
coverage: Research exact citations and Unicode offsets
CLI success, usage, file, parsing and schema errors
